verification_report.summary: Under the explicitly accepted internal inputs, the corollary and proof are correct. Smooth unbounded-mass witnesses exist at each required threshold; mixed-wedge positivity and the intermediate value theorem produce a parameter s_j in (0,epsilon_j) with the prescribed mass and strict lower positivity. The Gauduchon identity gives the claimed coefficient-L1 estimate and, with |tr A|≤tr|A|, whole-total-variation convergence of the full trace measures. The normalized L1 estimate and uniform exponential estimate apply with their stated constants; the construction is independent of p, and for each fixed p the convexity bound holds eventually. Constant b_j and divergent b_j give the two stated special cases. No external-paper reference occurs, and the final scope limitation is accurate.
